content:
Priya Singh: FYI I'm seeing a batch of inbound contacts aging in HS 'New' for >8m. Likely enrichment backlog again. Anyone on call?
Tom Herrera: Yep, caught the chart. Enrichment workers saturated during the midday spike, ~9m median lag. HubSpot rules currently wait on `company_domain_verified` before assigning. Leads pile up.
Nia Wallace: Can we implement a preemptive fallback that steps in at 8 minutes? Prefer queue assignment rather than permanent owner swap.
Priya Singh: Proposed: after 8m set owner -> Queue:Inbound-Fallback and set property `handoff_status` = "auto_enrichment_timeout_v2". Also add internal note to the contact.
Tom Herrera: Important: routing service must treat `handoff_status` flagged contacts as excluded from normal RR. I'll open a tiny patch: 
```json
{"routing": {"round_robin": {"ignore_if": ["handoff_status"]}}}
```
Nia Wallace: +1. Also need SFDC mapping: map Queue:Inbound-Fallback -> SF Queue (Inbound Overflow), and create a daily digest if queue size > 40.
RevOps Bot: deploy-bot: CI build for branch `fix/hs-fallback-8m` queued. Tests: routing unit + hs-workflow smoke. ETA 25m. :robot_face:
Jared Liu: Reconciliation concern: when enrichment finishes, do we overwrite queue owner? My vote: enrichment wins but only if `enrichment_assigned_rep` is populated and rep is active. Otherwise keep queue. Reconcile job every 12m.
Priya Singh: Agree. Reconcile logic: for contacts with `handoff_status` starting with "auto_enrichment", if `enrichment_assigned_rep` exists and `rep_active=true` then set owner=enrichment_assigned_rep, clear `handoff_status`, add note "reassigned by enrichment".
Tom Herrera: Also add a small lock field `auto_handoff_id` with TTL so we can trace who/when auto-assigned (helps audit and avoid double-rotation).
Nia Wallace: Can RevOps add an indexed property so we can query `handoff_status=auto_enrichment_timeout_v2` for dashboards? Need a card on marketing ops dashboard.
RevOps Bot: Reminder set: "hs-fallback-rollout-check" tomorrow 9:30am PT.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow text and a short playbook section with screenshots. Tom/Jared can review RR patch + reconcile job. Nia will prep dashboard widget and SF mapping. Quick sync tomorrow 9:30 PT?
Tom Herrera: Works for me. I'll add the routing PR and link the tests.
Jared Liu: LGTM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Nia Wallace: Thanks team, good to get this stabilized before next week's webinar spike.
